# JSON schemas

Each schema's `$id` is the URL it is served at, so an editor or a validator can fetch it from there.

| Schema | Title | Description |
|---|---|---|
| [`audit-v1.json`](/schemas/audit-v1.json) | relgap audit --format json | The report-v1.json envelope with audit data: the OSV advisories that affect the pinned tool versions under the roots, and the tool versions OSV wasn't asked about. |
| [`config-v1.json`](/schemas/config-v1.json) | relgap configuration | Schema for $XDG\_CONFIG\_HOME/relgap/config.yaml and .relgap.yaml. Generated from internal/config by `mise run test:golden -- -update`; do not edit. |
| [`digest-v1.json`](/schemas/digest-v1.json) | relgap digest --format json | The report-v1.json envelope with digest data: per tool, the versions in the range and the classified entries of their release notes. |
| [`drift-v1.json`](/schemas/drift-v1.json) | relgap drift --format json | The report-v1.json envelope with drift data: every resolved pin of the scanned repositories, grouped by tool, with the distinct versions they stand for. |
| [`outdated-v1.json`](/schemas/outdated-v1.json) | relgap outdated --format json | The report-v1.json envelope with outdated data: every resolved pin of the project compared with the latest version of its tool, sorted by tool, repo, file and line. |
| [`pins-v1.json`](/schemas/pins-v1.json) | relgap pins --format json | The report-v1.json envelope with pins data: the scanned repositories and every pin found, sorted by repo, file and line. |
| [`registry-v1.json`](/schemas/registry-v1.json) | relgap registry entry | One file per tool in registry/&lt;name&gt;.yaml. Check an entry with `relgap registry lint`. |
| [`report-v1.json`](/schemas/report-v1.json) | relgap JSON output envelope | Every --format json output is wrapped in this envelope. data is command-specific; its schemas are added per command. |
